title: Women: Do they even lift? (Dating/Relationships Q&A)
summary: A three-hour live Q&A on dating, relationships, friendships and power dynamics. NH answers questions on cheating, rejection, the black pill, meeting women, abusive partners and race in dating, and uses his own womanizer past and his marriage as examples. A few answers touch on lifting: muscle size versus strength in attraction, men who quit the gym once they are in a relationship, and what women mean by big muscles.
claims: You cannot stop a partner who wants to cheat; paranoia only pushes them away, so make cheating a hard boundary and leave if it happens
If you enjoy being alone and feel no need for a relationship, do not let others pressure you into one
A wandering eye is normal for men; constant cheating fantasies mean you should fix yourself or end the relationship, never cheat
To lose anxiety around women, interact often with women you are not romantically interested in so the stakes are lower
The male gaze strongly shapes what women do; the female gaze exists but has much less power
Race affects dating: many Western women see Asian men as less masculine and other races as more masculine
Partners should complement each other's weaknesses; he is paranoid and distrustful while his wife is kind and trusting, and they balance each other
He does not believe in love at first sight, but he knew his wife was special the first time he saw her, in a group of 30 people
Muscles speak for themselves; bragging about them puts women off
There are millions of possible soulmates, not one person you can miss forever
He regrets his womanizer phase because he hurt women; it made him a better seducer, not a better partner or person, and nobody needs to go through it
Being 33 and unmarried is not over for a man; it is the start of his life
Hookup culture is mostly destructive and something young men should avoid
A partner who asks for a summer break most likely wanted freedom; a break means the relationship is over, so do not take her back
He never had a heartbreak because he was always the one breaking up; he did not date in middle or high school and had his first real girlfriend at 22
The black pill is a self-fulfilling prophecy; stop consuming it, and know many of its creators profit from it while living fulfilled lives with wives and kids
Learn whether someone's values match yours by watching how they live and interact, not by interviewing them
Passport bros do find it easier because those women idealize Western men and are often poor, but meeting the high standards of Western women is the better challenge
Get rejected a lot to bulletproof your ego; in college he deliberately approached women he had no chance with, the first rejection crushed him for two weeks, and it later built his confidence
Women judge strength from muscle size because they do not know lifting numbers; benching three plates while getting fat will not impress them
A woman who makes you choose between her and the gym is not worth it unless she is a gym-cell
Men with low self-esteem fall for the first woman who gives them attention and keep ending up with toxic partners; build self-worth
If a partner threatens suicide to keep you, leave; that relationship is abusive and you owe them nothing
Compromise is healthy only if both sides make it; one-sided compromise breeds resentment
To resist cheating, imagine the thrill and then the guilt afterwards; the guilt is far worse, so avoid situations where you could cheat
Social anxiety with strangers comes from predicting how they will judge you; stay in the moment even if you look foolish
At university, join clubs to meet women and always greet women you know instead of avoiding them
Being jealous of a partner's past partners makes you look weak; she chose you over them
If you hate your appearance, spend a few years improving what hard work can change before considering surgery
Your standards should match what you bring to the table
Red flag: a woman with mostly male friends who says she dislikes women because of drama
Bringing a date to the gym kills your training intensity; keep your real sessions separate
Dating at work is risky and can follow you on your resume
You can be with someone whose politics differ completely if you agree on the fundamentals; his wife is his political opposite
Friends are the biggest factor in meeting women, and female friends give you social proof
Men who stop lifting once they get a girlfriend used it only as a tool to attract women; lifting is for self-improvement, and she may leave once the body goes
To meet women, step into female-dominated activities such as pottery, art, book clubs, literature classes and dance classes
His old direct approach of telling a woman he liked her and asking her out never worked
Neck training will not fix a weak skull shape, but a beard and a hairstyle that adds volume help
Mewing is just normal tongue posture; his coaches and parents always told him to breathe through his nose
Keep your social mask as close as possible to who you really are
He felt nothing for the women he dated before his wife; he committed because they clicked, and her patience won him over
Extroverted men have a big advantage in dating
Do not marry your first girlfriend if you will keep wondering about other women, but five years of happiness is strong evidence she is the one
Having options is for your own ego, not something to hold over a partner; women like the fantasy of taming a bad boy
Raise children within a moral framework rather than dogma, and let them choose religion when they are old enough
Vine metaphor: build yourself before a relationship; couples who grow intertwined from 15 can lose their formative years if it ends
His flaws are impulsivity, rigidity, pouting, impossible standards for others and near-paranoid distrust; his wife pushed him to work on them
To approach without being creepy, read body language, accept no, and only continue when she stops, makes eye contact and smiles
When a date gets postponed or cancelled, the next step is on her; that way you never look desperate
His own dealbreakers are short, blonde, or no glutes; men list mostly physical traits in partners
An introvert cannot become an extrovert; learn to manage a short social battery
Hold yourself to higher standards than you hold others
Young men becoming pretty boys is peacocking for women, not a sign of being gay; he opposes makeup
Traits that attract women: size from muscle and height, protection, resources, and facial features
Read philosophies that make you angry to find out who you are; if one book represents you completely, you are basic
Resolve conflict by cooling down, talking like adults, apologizing and never holding grudges
Leave a partner who insults or screams at you, especially at 17; insults test your boundaries before violence comes
He prefers groups where he is not the leader because power goes to his head and he is good at manipulating people
Do not stay in orbit around a woman who keeps you on the hook; cut it off
For a baby face: lift, train your neck and grow a beard; looking young pays off by 35
When women say they dislike big muscles they mean enhanced physiques or are posturing; to them pecs, a six-pack and some biceps is already big, and none ever told him he was too big

claims: Being too emotional is a handicap for a man
In college, talk to women in your classes; he approached about 3-4 women a month
After being cheated on, quit porn and social media that portray women badly and give real women a chance
If dating feels numb, take a break and treat each relationship as special
At 21, stop stressing about wife and family; life is long and social media lies about deadlines
Being small at 20 is normal; teens who look like Ronnie Coleman at 17 are the abnormal ones
In a relationship it is the two of you against the problem; if you stop fighting for it, maybe it is not worth it
Do not lose your virginity to an escort; an older friend did at 22 and called it the biggest regret of his life
Dysfunctional couples should split to fix themselves and then reunite, since staying together lets them avoid their problems
Looks matter, but the black pill is an emotional excuse for passivity; never give up
He wants an independent partner with her own life; if he died tomorrow he would want his wife to thrive
Moms who stop brothers from roughhousing keep boys from learning how male hierarchies work
Best first date is a walk in a nice neighborhood: low stakes, free and easy to leave; avoid restaurants, movies and your apartment
Rather than an anime waifu as motivation, model yourself after a male character you admire
Potential matters more than current money; he was broke when he met his wife, and firefighters are very popular with women
Keep only a few realistic non-negotiables; intelligence is his, while kids were negotiated with his wife
A partner who challenges you makes you better; one who treats you as always right makes you a worse man
Natural humor attracts women; trying too hard to be the clown fails
Porn is not cheating; the only person you cheat is yourself
Envy is one of the worst sins because there will always be someone better; practice being happy for others
Someone who is mean half the time is mean; alternating cruelty and kindness is the abuse cycle
Indian men face a tough Western dating market, while Middle Eastern and Black men are seen as masculine, sometimes to their detriment
He streams every Saturday 2-5 pm EST, rotating philosophy, fitness, self-improvement and dating, while handling job and legal problems
